title: Word gets around
text: Your reputation has outgrown the bedroom. Strangers undress you with their eyes at parties; someone's novel has a character who is obviously, flatteringly you. Prowess at {{s.sex.skill}} skill talks.

effects.tpl: You stop denying it. Winks, whispers, a waiting list. Fame has never been this much fun — or this hard to live down.
Modest to the end. 'Just rumors,' you lie, smiling. Somehow the rumors get worse — fondly.
